finance: Quick heads-up — launching an opt-in pilot for Usage Buffering and fairness smoothing next month. Short rundown and owners below.
finance: Pilot features: 1) Usage Buffering (opt-in): allow up to 25% of unused monthly credits to convert to buffer units that carry forward for up to 2 billing cycles. Non-cumulative beyond 2 cycles. Toggleable per-account in Console.
finance: 2) Fairness smoothing: during sustained 5+ minute spikes well apply gentle pacing to even out request acceptance across accounts. Behavior: advisory pacing headers, small added delay, minimal 429 advisory responses only when absolutely needed.
cal: Telemetry — will we expose this in headers/metrics?
finance: Yes. Headers: `X-RW-Flow: smoothing`, `X-RW-Flow-Delay-ms: <n>`, `X-RW-Buffer-State: active|cap`. Metrics: `billing.buffer.events` and `billing.smoothing.events` with account_id and delay_ms tags.
sam.f: Partners need an invoice estimate API so they can show projected rollover/overage in portals.
finance: New endpoint: `GET /v1/billing/estimate_invoice?account_id=...&period=...` returning CSV-friendly rows. We'll publish OpenAPI examples.
support: What do we tell customers about latency and retries? Any SLO changes?
finance: No SLO changes in pilot. Messaging: "During smoothing windows, requests may see ~150-450ms extra latency; we favor slowdowns over hard drops. Retries with backoff are safe." We'll provide canned replies and an FAQ.
marta: Please add a Console alert when buffer reaches cap so customers aren't surprised.
finance: Good call. Add alert + CTA: spend credits or contact AM. Also add changelog entry.
anya: How do customers opt in?
finance: Console -> Billing -> Credits -> Enable "Usage Buffering (pilot)". Support can flip the flag manually for early cohort before UI is live.
jamie: Does this affect Dedicated deployments?
finance: Dedicated pools are excluded from platform smoothing by default; they may opt into buffering if their billing plane is managed by us.
ops-bot: Schedule note: console flag rollout begins 2026-05-20 -> 100% by 2026-05-27. Enforcement for pilot cohort starts 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z.
billing-bot: Policy created: brl-2026-05-01-usage-smoothing. Public comms planned for rollout day.
support: We'll need the pilot account CSV to coordinate AM outreach and pre-roll emails.
finance: Sharing CSV with Support & AMs on 2026-05-10. Cohort ≈ 200 customers (starter + select midmarket).
cal: Dev note — tag smoothing events with `smoothing_source=usage_smoothing_v1` for easy queries.
finance: Also adding an invoice preview email 48h before billing that shows buffer applied and any projected overage. Blog + changelog + Console banner on rollout day.
support: Drafting customer email and FAQ now; will post link here when ready.
finance: Thanks — ping me for the OpenAPI or CSV early. We'll update this thread as docs and console flags land. :white_check_mark:
